THREE SCOPE NOTES A DECOMP MUST CARRY, none of them the decomp's to decide away: (1) MORATORIUM EXCEPTIONS ARE NOW FWD-4/5/6/12 (commissioning word) PLUS FWD-14/15 (Andrew-direct 2026-09-02: the auto-block sentinel and its email). NOTHING BEYOND THOSE SIX. His word names ONE recipient, andrew@opalinvest.com, and ONE trigger; it authorizes NO other recipient, NO other channel and NO other cadence, and CLAUDE.md's standing bar on building alarms/monitors/notifications without his explicit ask binds everything else in this scope. An assessment naming a detection gap does NOT self-authorize the detector -- and this project's whole brief is a list of gaps, which is exactly where that inference gets made. (2) Every EXERCISED bar is to be met by a read-only or self-targeted probe -- no unannounced writes to production. (3) FWD-14 IS AN AUTOMATIC BLOCKING MECHANISM AND ITS FALSE POSITIVE LOCKS OUT A WHOLE FIRM: a persistent block must never fire on an ALLOW-listed partner egress, since one address can front an entire firm. 1.0.0_SA_CTO~Z's design constraints are to be inherited as atoms rather than rediscovered -- the DDB table is the source of truth and the WAF IP set is DERIVED from it via a stream (so unblock and expiry fall out of one write); the persistent block sits tiered above the transient rate rule and carries an expiry; one email per address per incident with 24h suppression plus a daily digest, never one per request. Thresholds are STARTING values to be tuned on a month of WATCH rows, never invented as final.
